scripts.on_start:
local skill = ...
local buttons = {}
for i = 1, 6 do
    local button = "Skill" .. i
    if skill.button(button) then buttons[#buttons + 1] = button end
end
-- Capture once: another skill button must not take over this hold later.
skill.vars.magic_evade_buttons = buttons
scripts.on_frame:
local skill = ...
local buttons = skill.vars.magic_evade_buttons or {}
if #buttons == 0 then
    skill.log("Magic Evade: no held Skill1..Skill6 input detected; ending safely")
    skill.finish()
    return
end
for _, button in ipairs(buttons) do
    if not skill.button(button) then
        -- end.exit_action requests Job04_AbsoluteAvoidanceEnd on normal finish.
        skill.finish()
        return
    end
end
